title: Prove a complete-cost obstruction for eight two-accumulator rewrites
body:
Eight explicit saved-arm rewrites make the two-accumulator escape in [PR #1238](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1238) concrete on the selected R480 local word. Every subset passes the exact local scalar, frame, entrance, and helper-cone checks. The all-eight word also passes native emission, independent replay, wrappers, and all 2,900 exact local phase edges. The helpers are arbitrary inputs; cleanup and the width-7 to width-9 changes are paid.

Review files: [Proof and scope](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bb7fc427c79c26669a9e8de06e55f31cadaa992d/research/two-accumulator-saved-arms/PROOF.md) · [Evidence](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bb7fc427c79c26669a9e8de06e55f31cadaa992d/research/two-accumulator-saved-arms/NATIVE-REPLAY.md) · [Source pins and credit](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bb7fc427c79c26669a9e8de06e55f31cadaa992d/research/two-accumulator-saved-arms/SOURCES.json).

The complete cost excludes an improvement from this method. A signed whole-helper inequality and two strict-majorization arguments prove that every nonempty use has a smaller complex root than the applicable unchanged-word [PR #1129](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1129) optimum. The result permits arbitrary per-call subsets, every positive replica count, and every owner with the retained capacity stock. The zero-recipe choice attains the family optimum, with inherited conditional kappa `0.001674097969905390`. No new kappa is claimed.

This proof covers the eight fixed recipes. It does not close the original wider problem of arbitrary partitions, rational encodings, new frame schedules, mixed encodings across packets, or composition with [PR #1319](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1319). Those boundaries and the failed attempts are explicit. The input is bound directly to the selected [PR #1094](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1094) replay archive, and the 57,478-state feasible raw frame schedule is retained as a positive control.

Reproduce with Python 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/two-accumulator-saved-arms
```

Expected final line: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/two-accumulator-saved-arms outcome=negative-result`.

The package checks all 256 words, the 712-column private-centre scalar interface for the all-eight word, three failure controls, all 1,163 bin patterns by two methods, exact supporting intervals, the baseline attaining table, and both majorization relations. The coordinator independently reproduced the family check and the native local checks. No new global owner stream or complete cold multiplication replay is claimed. Inherited all-size and analytic obligations remain.

Base: [bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f). Source commits, byte hashes, native replay commands, and predecessor notices are in the package. Credit [PR #1238](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1238), [PR #1140](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1140), [PR #1129](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1129), [PR #1240](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1240), [PR #1012](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1012), [PR #1198](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1198), and the retained seven-slot/native lineage.
